title: Fortune Craft
description: The Official Modpack for the FortuneCraft Modded Server. Explore Minecraft in a new light with a heavy focus on Create, with the addition of new Biomes, Blocks, Mobs and Bosses!
body:
Welcome to the Official Fortune Craft Network Modpack. This Modpack comes pre-installed with various mods to spice up your regular Minecraft sessions with new blocks, bosses, farming and most importantly a heavy focus on Create with the inclusion of the brand new Create: Aeronautics.

Each playsession will always be different and you can check it out for yourself and join us online via the Fortune Craft Server **mc.fortunecraft.net** or on [Discord](https://discord.gg/Xv8HgDW7ug)!

Adventure awaits...
